Author: CoelZzz
Name: Raid Helper
Description:
Shows a compact helper window with live mechanic calls for supported fights.

Dancing Mad (Ultimate): P1 rings, gazes, rocks and cleaves; P2 Forsaken and Trine; P3 Black Hole and hand attacks; P4 debuffs; P5 Chaotic Flood.

The Epic of Alexander (Ultimate): P2 nisi lineup; P3 Wormhole; P4 Fate Calibration Alpha and Beta.
Punchline: Mechanic calls for high-end raids, one fight at a time.
Changelog: TEA: role helper adds WAR, WHM and SGE (cooldown plans, P1 tornado directions, P2 positions, nisi partners, Link-Up, Enumeration, WAR ice drop). The role helper is now off by default - pick your role (or Auto) in the TEA settings.

Author: CoelZzz
Name: Alt Relay
Description:
Keeps a list of your characters and works through them one at a time, logging in to each with Lifestream.

Cap tomes: checks this week's limited tomestones and runs the dungeon paying the most of them that the character can enter, with AutoDuty in Duty Support or Trust, until the weekly cap is reached.

Run main story: runs Questionable on each character until it stops, usually at a duty it can't do, and names that duty.

Run allied dailies: runs today's daily quests of the combat allied societies with Questionable, until the allowances run out.

Run event quests: runs the current seasonal event's quests with Questionable.

Refresh all: logs in to every character just to read its tomestones, main story progress, allowances and event quests.

Each character can be switched to a chosen job, in its best gear set. When every character is done it can log out, close the game or run your own commands.

Needs Lifestream, plus AutoDuty for tomes or Questionable for the quest tasks. AutoRetainer is optional.
Punchline: Cap tomestones, play the main story, allied society dailies or seasonal events on every character.
Changelog: Run event quests now reads Questionable's own event table, the one its window shows, so it finds All Saints' Wake 2026 from anywhere, inn rooms included. The 0.1.2.0 festival reading only worked in cities and the open world, and stays as a fallback. New Dependencies tab in the settings: each task's plugins, with a green check when loaded and a red cross when missing.
